items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I remember Henry Hardin had a band too. His band used to play at the rhythm club too.

ctx.x: We used to talk a lot. And he always wanted to get a band together. And have a band. We were friends with Claude Kerr. I remember Henry Hardin had a band too. His band used to play at the rhythm club too.
Hardin, H-A-R-D-I-N? Yeah. Were you first of friends with Clyde Kerr?
